cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to lend you my umbrella. How long is the proposed loan?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An open-ended duration. Do you have a guarantor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come under here to sign. I'll hold the umbrella over the terms.
